g.title: client
g.text: with fresh request ID + caller idempotency key

g.title: prestart_failed
g.text: Append one standalone durable Failed audit
for an intrinsically audited pre-start failure

g.title: denied
g.text: Append one standalone durable Denied audit

g.title: prestart_return
g.text: Audit durable: return original safe failure

g.title: audit_outage
g.text: Standalone / Started append not proven durable

g.title: denied_return
g.text: audit failure marks unhealthy; unknown also fences writes

g.title: poststart_return
g.text: Audit durable: return selected safe denial / failure / cancellation

g.title: poststart_outage
g.text: Terminal append abort / unknown before admission

g.title: reserve
g.text: 8 Create or resume durable Pending reservation
fixed tx.time • input hash • admission request ID • plan

g.title: audit_terminal
g.text: 16 Attempt the selected terminal audit once

g.title: lock
g.text: 9 Derive and acquire canonical conflict keys

g.title: run
g.text: and exact plan, then returns EvaluatedCommand

g.title: provenance
g.text: 12 For a successfully evaluated new attempt only:
obtain one ProvenanceId before opening write transaction

g.title: coord
g.text: 13 Assemble CommitIntent from exact stored admission/claims
then recheck reservation, dependencies, predicates, capability

g.title: durable
g.text: 14 Assign CommitSequence and atomically persist terminal set
admission • entities • indexes • outcome • event + intent
provenance • commit record (no initial outbox status)

g.title: shape
g.text: 15 Fully filter, redact, and bound the semantic result

g.title: projection
g.text: Projection applies commit N to one identity/generation
then atomically persists rows • marker N • frontier N

g.title: retry
g.text: with a fresh RequestId, or calls GetOutcome

g.title: normal
g.text: commit sequence only when the stored outcome has one
